description:
This is a notice of intent to award a sole source contract to Telonics, Inc., 932 E. Impala Avenue, Mesa, Arizona 85204. This is not a competitive Request for Quote.
The Contracting Operations Central, Northern Rockies Major Acquisition Buying Office (MABO), intends to issue a Sole Source award for refurbishing nineteen (19) Telonics TGW-4677 and five (5) TGW-4577 GPS collars with CR-5 mechanisms for the National Park Service (NPS), Yellowstone National Park. Please see attached for additional information.
